description: This file defines the RemoteImageNode class, a custom lexical node for embedding images in a lexical editor with serialization, DOM conversion, and rendering support.

classes.name: RemoteImageNode
classes.description: A custom lexical node representing an embedded remote image, supporting serialization, DOM import/export, and rendering via React component.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for this node, 'unencrypted-image'.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new RemoteImageNode with source URL and optional alt text.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the given RemoteImageNode.

methods.name: importJSON
methods.description: Creates a RemoteImageNode instance from its serialized JSON representation.

methods.name: exportJSON
methods.description: Serializes the node into a JSON object for storage or transmission.

methods.name: importDOM
methods.description: Provides DOM conversion rules for importing HTML elements into this node.

methods.name: exportDOM
methods.description: Creates a DOM representation of this node, specifically an element.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Renders the node as a React component (RemoteImageComponent) within the lexical editor.
